IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = 'DIM_TIEMPO' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = 'dbo')
CREATE TABLE dbo.DIM_TIEMPO
	(
	 [IdDIMTIEMPO] int,
	 [Fecha] date,
	 [Anio] int,
	 [Mes] int,
	 [NombreMes] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Dia] int,
	 [NombreDia] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Semana] int,
	 [Trimestre] int,
	 [Semestre] int
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO

--Uncomment the 4 lines below to create a stored procedure for data pipeline orchestration​

COPY INTO dbo.DIM_TIEMPO
(IdDIMTIEMPO 1, Fecha 2, Anio 3, Mes 4, NombreMes 5, Dia 6, NombreDia 7, Semana 8, Trimestre 9, Semestre 10)
FROM 'https://azpaciencareetl.dfs.core.windows.net/datosprocesados/dw/DIM_TIEMPO.PARQUET'
WITH
(
	FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET'
	,MAXERRORS = 0
)
--END
GO

SELECT TOP 100 * FROM dbo.DIM_TIEMPO
GO
